text:
anya patel: Launch Mosaic push tomorrow AM. Need final hero + 2x variants, microthread for X, long LinkedIn post, UTMs, and inbound routing. Quick sync. :mosaic:
kai wong: uploading hero 28s + square + vertical thumbs now. will add alt text and post paths. :camera_with_flash:
riley park: i have two headline directions: performance-first and savings-first. we should A/B test. also draft of LN longform ready. sam will own replies?
sam irwin: can do replies + triage DMs. will post short reply templates for pricing, models, and private deploys.
anya patel: UTM: ```?utm_source=social&utm_medium={platform}&utm_campaign=mosaic_launch_2024&utm_content={variant}``` replace {variant} with x-perf / x-savings / ln-story.
social-scheduler: X queued 08:30 PST (microthread + hero + thumb-a). LinkedIn queued 09:00 PST (ln-long + static). Preflight ping at 08:00 PST.
kai wong: uploaded assets to /marketing/assets/mosaic/ (hero28.mp4, thumb-square.jpg, thumb-vertical.jpg). alt text in notes.
anya patel: Microthread outline: root hook + 3 replies. Sam drop the three replies short & punchy.
sam irwin: Posting microthread:
Root: Building LLM features shouldn't force you to pick speed or cost. Mosaic delivers consistent latency and better unit economics. Demo + checklist: <link>?utm_content=x-perf
Reply 1: Dash peek 1 realtime token-level costs + per-route SLAs.
Reply 2: Autoscale show: kept latency stable during heavy bursts (customer vignette).
Reply 3: Register for demo + 10-min setup guide. link in comment. :sparkles:
riley park: tweak for LinkedIn: replace 'link in comment' with 'registration link' and expand the customer vignette. I'll post LN copy in a sec.
anya patel: Engagement: Riley draft reply templates for top-8 Qs. Sam will monitor 08:4511:30 PST then handoff to community. Jordan (cc) to wire Airtable for registrants.
jess-bot: reminder: preflight checklist will post at 08:00 PST to this thread. :robot_face:
social-scheduler: preflight completed at 08:01 PST: assets present, UTMs validated, posts scheduled.
anya patel: final ask: split test headline: speed vs savings (50/50). label variants x-perf-A / x-savings-B. track impressions & CTR; report after 2hrs. Good run everyone. :thumbsup:
